title: Build a Filter with Flexible Inputs
short_description: Filter tasks from values, refs, or getters without losing reactive tracking.
description: App.vue already consumes useTaskFilter with a reactive collection and query.
Complete the composable to normalize both inputs with toValue and derive visible tasks through computed.
instructions: Read tasks and query with toValue inside computed.
Normalize the query by trimming outer whitespace and converting it to lowercase.
Return every task when the query is empty.
Filter by title without case sensitivity when a query exists.
You only need to modify useTaskFilter.ts.

hints.title: Normalize each input
hints.body: `toValue(tasks)` obtains the current collection and `toValue(query)` obtains the current text, whether they arrive as values, refs, or getters.

hints.title: Keep reactive tracking
hints.body: Call `toValue` inside the `computed` callback so Vue tracks any refs or getters that are used.

hints.title: Empty query
hints.body: After trimming, you can return `currentTasks` immediately when `normalizedQuery` is an empty string.
